comparison: 2020 derived 1mi1 coal/gas supply ratio vs Ember estimated provincial generation ratio; 30 province-level units; cross-source disagreement, not ground-truth error
factor_assumption: 2024 official annual technology carbon-footprint factors: coal .9240, gas .4503, bioenergy .0404, wind .0324, solar .0520 kgCO2e/kWh; other fossil EF bounded by coal/gas hull; these are not hourly operational CIF factors
limits: 1mi1 source is a derived supply estimate from provincial energy-balance and fuel-consumption data with common plant-use-rate assumptions; it is not direct generation by fuel.
Ember is a model-based estimate. Cross-source differences are not true errors and sources may share underlying NBS/CEC information.
One year and 30 regions do not validate temporal or future-province calibration.
The interval frontier conditions on Ember coal+gas/other-fossil/bioenergy composition and only calibrates coal-vs-gas ratio; other-fossil EF is conservatively placed on coal/gas hull.
2024 life-cycle factors are annual and applied to 2025-26 month shares only as a sensitivity scenario; no hourly label or coverage claim.

cross_validated_point_calibration.interpretation: Simple global bias shift improves pooled LOPO MAE but worsens the Shanghai held-out error; affine calibration is weaker and ridge is unstable.
